related_evidence.description: CTAD 2025 presentation on the feasibility of self-administered subcutaneous remternetug in the Phase 3 TRAILRUNNER-ALZ 1 trial.

evidence_assessment: The document correctly outlines TRAILRUNNER-ALZ 3, an ongoing Phase 3 trial for Eli Lilly's remternetug, a subcutaneous follow-on to their approved anti-amyloid donanemab (Kisunla). Clinical evidence supporting this program is grounded in earlier Phase 1 studies demonstrating dose-dependent amyloid plaque lowering, alongside the recently completed 1,667-patient TRAILRUNNER-ALZ 1 Phase 3 trial. While full cognitive endpoint readouts from TRAILRUNNER-ALZ 1 are still pending broader peer-reviewed publication, interim reporting at CTAD 2025 highlighted the feasibility of subcutaneous self-administration. Definitive efficacy data evaluating remternetug's ability to delay cognitive and functional decline remains a future milestone, which TRAILRUNNER-ALZ 3 is accurately designed to measure over a multi-year period concluding in 2030.
